notes.title: Mac Version and Russian Localization
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We want to say thank you all! We received a lot of messages, reports and feedback from all of you that played the game! That means a lot 

We had a lot of work to create LunarAxe and was amazing to see you playing and telling us how you fell about the game. 

Today, i'm here to tell about some updates that we are working on. Mainly in 3:
- Mac Version: We're making tests and creating a build for those with MAC OS to also play Lunar Axe
- New Hint: We've heard some ideias and feedback about the lantern in LunarAxe, so we'll make some updates on inventory and hint system to create a better experience (coming up in fixes 006)
- Russian Localization: We've noted and received some bug reports about russian text font. We're working to fix this problem soon as possible

notes.title: Demo update and development plan
notes.notes:
Hello! It's been a while but today we're releasing a major update to Lunar Axe! This update contains improvements, additional content and new features requested by the community.
The game has 4 major stages of development and at the moment we are almost at the end of stage 2.
Below is a list of the changes that you can already experience in the demo and also a little explanation about the plans for the project:

- New UI
- Object Highlight System
- Tasks and Documents System
- Updates on stage 2
- Game Development Plan

New UI
After a lot of effort, we remade the game's interface in order to improve the player experience.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38700276/3862e314a2554fd81b3c76f44f5ead9194d06eca.gif

In addition, we added visual elements and content adjustments to improve the gameplay.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38700276/a35b00492c6cfda530291fd5f1c04293e365fe57.gif

Object Highlight System
Now you can choose the difficulty of the game. This will impact the Highlight System, which will indicate the presence of elements on the scene that can be collected.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38700276/33564d729db11ac84acad613d062ce3326bd70dc.gif

 Tasks and Documents System 
We added a list of objectives that must be completed in order to progress in the game. Now it is also possible to access all the files found during the journey so players can have a better understandig of the story.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38700276/a10bf3ac5e119337ee18ee8498c4bfb8bd0961e0.gif

 Updates on Stage 2 
We are almost finishing the second major stage of the project with new puzzles, handmade art and new scenarios for you to explore. Stay tuned for more info on this soon!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38700276/0320b55115bf7ae46c8f05ddc28f918419a37e9e.png

 Game development plan 
Lunar Axe have 4 major development stages and we are planning to launch the full version of the game in the second half of 2021. The official launch date and next stages are expected to be announced in the coming months.

We want to thank everyone who played our demo and added the game to the their wishlists! It's a great motivation and gives us strength during the production. We are posting constant updates on our twitter so follow us there to learn more about the Lunar Axe development process.

Soon we will bring updates for the current languages ​​and add more options planned to the final version.
